UserClubState.title: UserClubState
UserClubState.description: Stores the user's synced EA Sports FC 27 Ultimate Team Xbox Series S club state. Unknown fields remain null (blank) rather than guessed.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the club owner.

consolePlatform.description: Target console market platform (locked to Xbox Series S).

clubName.description: Display name of the user's FC 27 Ultimate Team club, or null if not provided.

coins.description: Current Xbox Series S Coin balance (e.g. 35000), or null if blank.

fifaPoints.description: Current FC/FIFA Points balance, or null if blank.

rivalsDivision.description: Current Division Rivals division (e.g. 'Division 3' or 'Elite'), or null if blank.

dailySp.description: Match-earned Season Points today (0-850 SP cap), or null if blank.

galleryLevel.description: Overall FUT Gallery collection level (1-100), or null if blank.

antigravityVersion.description: Resolved Antigravity 2.0 Desktop App firmware version at T=0.

fc27PatchVersion.description: Resolved EA Sports FC 27 Title Update / Live Tuning version at T=0.

lastT0Anchor.description: British Time (Europe/London) ISO timestamp of last sync.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial club creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest sync mutation.

TrackedInvestment.title: TrackedInvestment
TrackedInvestment.description: Stores a user's tracked FC 27 Xbox Series S market flip, Holographic arbitrage position, or Gallery Rent-and-Flip target.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the investor.

playerId.description: Unique FC 27 Xbox Series S player identifier.

buyPrice.description: Xbox Series S purchase or target bid price in coins.

targetSellPrice.description: Target sale price on Xbox Series S before 5% EA tax.

/users/{userId}.description: Root user club document keyed by the authenticated user's UID.

/users/{userId}/investments/{investmentI.description: Subcollection of tracked FC 27 Xbox Series S market investments owned by the parent user.
